explanation: This is 0 everywhere except at the GO step of the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 to 99, never earlier), where it is about 10 if the agent chooses a1 and the previous trial was rewarded (about 9 on the first such trial after an unrewarded one). At those late GO steps it is 0 to 2 if the previous trial was unrewarded, and 0 if the agent chooses a2 after a reward; D1 and D2 are always 0.
